en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an industrial and rural waterfront landscape with stacked timber, fenced areas and a river or harbor in the foreground. In the middle distance are factory buildings with tall chimneys emitting smoke, and in the background low forested hills. On a hill to the right stand several large houses. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom, and there is cursive handwriting over the lower part of the image.
